PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Ceramic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ceramic Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceramic Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceramic Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceramic Materials.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard
